professionalSummary.text: Three years of experience as a Maintenance Planning Coordinator at a paper mill operating two paper machines, responsible for building weekly maintenance plans, sequencing shutdowns, managing spare parts reservations, preparing plan reviews, and documenting open items.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintenance planning coordinator at a paper mill with two paper machines for three years, building each week's maintenance plan from the open work orders under the mill's planning procedure in the maintenance system.

experienceHighlights.text: Built weekly maintenance plans from open work orders following the mill's planning procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Sequenced shutdown work packages with machine crews, ensuring production manager approval.
experienceHighlights.witness: Sequenced the shutdown work packages with the two machine crews for the monthly shutdowns; the shutdown approval was the production manager's, recorded on the shutdown plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained current spare parts reservations in collaboration with the stores team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the spare parts reservations current for planned work with the stores team, with the reservation report reconciled each week.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly plan reviews for the maintenance manager, documenting plan changes and crew feedback.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented plan open items and hand-over conditions each week.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the plan's open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next week's planning at each review.
